rollback: Retain wall-clock expiry and fence checks; disable affected scheduling on regression. Never revert to transaction-start lease authorization. Financial settlement after expiry/deletion remains allowed under existing receipt rules.
issuanceScope: Lease validity is checked again after action/intent INSERTs before the issuance transaction returns. This is local durable authorization evidence, not external exactly-once delivery or a guarantee against arbitrary process pauses between transaction commit and transport.
